design: Two paired blocks with reversed method order; not a claim of full randomization or cancellation of nonlinear drift. Reset every run to fresh weights. No parameter edits. Record voltage/temperature and keep mechanical start/warm-up/rest protocol comparable. Do not charge midway through a paired block; interrupt and document any hardware/condition change rather than silently treating records as matched.
sealedFirmware: Copies keep original targets/build IDs and all source bytes. Existing AXF/HEX copied unchanged; download the copied sealed executable without rebuilding. If Keil requests recompilation or an image check fails, stop for review. Do not erase or alter the archived originals.
start: During flash keep motor-drive power off. After successful user download, prepare the empty-load platform, clear VOFA history and enable reception BEFORE the deliberate fresh reset/power-on. Verify the expected I21/I63 identity; controller auto-arms after about8seconds if health and stationary checks pass. Do not reset again within a recording. Zero command is not a holding brake.
export: All107 channels. On success phase6/fault0, wait for method-specific eventMagic in I88 and I89=4; retain >=5seconds after that. Use absolute I0>=100s for both as a simple minimum, but status4 remains required. Do not stop reception at phase6 alone. Export same history before clearing.
abnormal: On abnormal motion, vibration, noise, travel or fault: stop safely; preserve same history and fault replay at least5seconds if safe. Pause the block for review. Retain failed attempts and do not overwrite/delete/retry to select favorable outcomes.
analysis: Phase2-5 mean-position tracking RMSE and left-right synchronization RMS on exact common elapsed timestamps, without interpolation; also report max tracking, max sync, per-axis errors, commands/constraints/learning/nodes, voltage/temperature, faults, timing and event completeness. Event windows differ and are diagnostic only, not interchangeable samples for mechanism superiority.
screening: A safe and complete first run permits paired replication, not an efficacy declaration. After four records, summarize every outcome and paired differences. No objective task tracking tolerance has been supplied; report tradeoffs only. These exploratory records do not enter the future independent15trial formal set.
